name: 维亚切斯拉夫·莫洛托夫

points.place: 维亚特卡省库卡尔卡村
points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 维亚切斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇·斯克里亚宾（后改名为莫洛托夫）出生于维亚特卡省的一个小村庄。他的父亲是店员，母亲是家庭主妇。莫洛托夫在喀山接受教育，展现出对政治的早期兴趣。1906年，他加入俄国社会民主工党布尔什维克派，开始参与革命活动。这一时期，他接触了马克思主义思想，并开始参与地下革命工作，为日后的政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Vyacheslav Mikhailovich Skryabin (later known as Molotov) was born in a small village in Vyatka Governorate. His father was a clerk and his mother a housewife. Molotov received his education in Kazan, showing early interest in politics. In 1906, he joined the Bolshevik faction of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party and began participating in revolutionary activities. During this period, he was exposed to Marxist ideas and began underground revolutionary work, laying the foundation for his future political career.

points.title: 革命活动
points.description: 在圣彼得堡，莫洛托夫成为布尔什维克党的活跃成员，与列宁和斯大林建立了密切联系。他参与了《真理报》的编辑工作，使用'莫洛托夫'作为笔名，这个名字后来成为他的正式姓氏。1917年二月革命后，他继续在彼得格勒从事革命工作，并在十月革命期间担任重要角色。这一时期，莫洛托夫展现出组织能力和政治敏锐性，成为布尔什维克党内的年轻骨干。
points.descriptionEn: In Saint Petersburg, Molotov became an active member of the Bolshevik Party, establishing close ties with Lenin and Stalin. He worked as an editor for the newspaper Pravda, using 'Molotov' as his pen name, which later became his official surname. After the February Revolution of 1917, he continued revolutionary work in Petrograd and played a significant role during the October Revolution. During this period, Molotov demonstrated organizational skills and political acumen, becoming a young骨干 of the Bolshevik Party.

points.title: 内战时期
points.description: 俄国内战期间，莫洛托夫在莫斯科担任重要职务，负责粮食供应和后勤工作。他参与了红军的组建，并在伏尔加河流域组织粮食征购，为红军提供物资保障。这一时期，莫洛托夫展现出强硬的执行力和对布尔什维克事业的坚定忠诚。1920年，他被任命为乌克兰共产党中央委员会书记，负责恢复战后秩序。这段经历使他在党内积累了丰富的行政经验，也为他日后在斯大林政府中的崛起奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: During the Russian Civil War, Molotov held important positions in Moscow, responsible for food supply and logistics. He participated in the formation of the Red Army and organized grain requisitions in the Volga region, providing material support for the Red Army. During this period, Molotov demonstrated strong executive ability and unwavering loyalty to the Bolshevik cause. In 1920, he was appointed Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Ukraine, responsible for restoring post-war order. This experience accumulated valuable administrative experience for him, laying the foundation for his later rise in Stalin's government.

points.title: 外交部长
points.description: 1929年，莫洛托夫被任命为苏联外交人民委员，正式进入苏联外交决策核心。他推行'和平共处'外交政策，同时加强苏联在国际舞台上的影响力。1933年，他成功与美国建立外交关系，成为苏联外交的重大突破。1939年，他代表苏联与德国外长里宾特洛甫签署《苏德互不侵犯条约》，震惊世界。这一条约虽然为苏联争取了备战时间，但也使苏联与西方国家关系恶化。作为外交部长，莫洛托夫展现出灵活的外交手腕和坚定的国家立场，成为斯大林外交政策的主要执行者。
points.descriptionEn: In 1929, Molotov was appointed People's Commissar for Foreign Affairs, formally entering the core of Soviet foreign policy decision-making. He pursued a policy of 'peaceful coexistence' while strengthening Soviet influence on the international stage. In 1933, he successfully established diplomatic relations with the United States, a major breakthrough for Soviet diplomacy. In 1939, he signed the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact with German Foreign Minister Ribbentrop on behalf of the Soviet Union, shocking the world. Although this treaty bought precious time for Soviet rearmament, it also deteriorated relations between the Soviet Union and Western countries. As Foreign Minister, Molotov demonstrated flexible diplomatic skills and firm national positions, becoming the main executor of Stalin's foreign policy.

points.title: 卫国战争
points.description: 二战期间，莫洛托夫担任苏联人民委员会主席（相当于总理），成为战时政府核心成员。他负责协调苏联战争经济，领导国家转入战时体制。1941年，他在斯大林之后成为苏联最高苏维埃主席团主席，代表苏联参与国际会议。1942年，他访问伦敦，与丘吉尔和艾德礼会谈，建立反法西斯同盟。1943年，他参加德黑兰会议，与罗斯福和斯大林讨论战后世界格局。这一时期，莫洛托夫展现出卓越的组织能力和外交才能，为苏联在二战中的胜利做出重要贡献。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Molotov served as Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars (equivalent to Prime Minister), becoming a core member of the wartime government. He was responsible for coordinating the Soviet war economy and leading the country into a wartime system. In 1941, after Stalin, he became Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, representing the Soviet Union in international conferences. In 1942, he visited London and met with Churchill and Attlee to establish the anti-fascist alliance. In 1943, he attended the Tehran Conference, discussing the post-war world order with Roosevelt and Stalin. During this period, Molotov demonstrated outstanding organizational skills and diplomatic talent, making significant contributions to the Soviet victory in World War II.

points.title: 晚年政治
points.description: 1957年，莫洛托夫因反对赫鲁晓夫的去斯大林化政策而被解除所有职务，并被开除出党。1964年，他恢复党籍但未重返政治舞台。在晚年，莫洛托夫撰写回忆录，捍卫斯大林时期的政策。他始终坚定支持斯大林主义，认为赫鲁晓夫的改革是修正主义。1984年，莫洛托夫被重新接纳为苏共党员，成为苏联历史上最长寿的政治家之一。1986年，他在莫斯科逝世，享年96岁。莫洛托夫的晚年反映了苏联政治的复杂性，也体现了他作为斯大林时代忠实拥护者的政治立场。
points.descriptionEn: In 1957, Molotov was removed from all positions and expelled from the party for opposing Khrushchev's de-Stalinization policies. In 1964, his party membership was restored but he did not return to political life. In his later years, Molotov wrote memoirs defending the policies of the Stalin era. He remained a staunch supporter of Stalinism, considering Khrushchev's reforms as revisionist. In 1984, Molotov was readmitted to the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, becoming one of the longest-lived politicians in Soviet history. He died in Moscow in 1986 at the age of 96. Molotov's later years reflected the complexity of Soviet politics and embodied his political stance as a loyal supporter of the Stalin era.

appraisal.zh: 莫洛托夫是斯大林时代的主要执行者，也是苏联外交体系的重要构建者，其生涯折射出二十世纪苏联政治的复杂性。他推动工业化与国防建设，作为外交部长维护国家利益，被视为斯大林最可靠的政治家之一；但另一种看法认为，他忠实执行大清洗与镇压政策，签署《苏德互不侵犯条约》，对数百万人死亡负有责任，是斯大林主义暴行的同谋，被解职后仍固守旧立场。这种功过悬殊的矛盾，使他成为研究苏联历史的重要案例。
appraisal.en: Molotov was a principal executor of the Stalin era and an important architect of the Soviet diplomatic system, his career reflecting the complexity of twentieth-century Soviet politics. He promoted industrialization and defense construction and, as Foreign Minister, safeguarded national interests, and is regarded as one of Stalin's most reliable politicians. Yet another view holds that he loyally carried out the Great Purge and repression, signed the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact, bore responsibility for the deaths of millions, and remained an accomplice to Stalinist atrocities, clinging to his old stance even after dismissal. This stark contradiction makes him an important case study in Soviet history.

supporter.zh: 莫洛托夫被视为苏联社会主义建设的坚定捍卫者和卓越管理者。支持者认为他在苏联工业化、农业集体化和卫国战争中的贡献不可磨灭。作为外交部长，他成功维护了苏联国家利益，为苏联赢得了宝贵的和平发展时间。莫洛托夫的务实作风和坚定立场，使他成为斯大林时代最可靠的政治家之一，为苏联成为世界超级大国奠定了基础。
supporter.en: Molotov is regarded as a steadfast defender and excellent administrator of Soviet socialist construction. Supporters believe his contributions to Soviet industrialization, agricultural collectivization, and the Great Patriotic War are indelible. As Foreign Minister, he successfully safeguarded Soviet national interests and bought precious time for peaceful development. Molotov's pragmatic style and firm stance made him one of the most reliable politicians of the Stalin era, laying the foundation for the Soviet Union to become a superpower.

critic.zh: 批评者认为莫洛托夫是斯大林大清洗和镇压政策的忠实执行者，对数百万人的死亡负有责任。他签署的《苏德互不侵犯条约》被视为对国际共产主义运动的背叛，也为苏联后来的外交困境埋下隐患。莫洛托夫的极端忠诚和对斯大林政策的无条件执行，使他成为斯大林主义暴行的同谋。在赫鲁晓夫时代被解职后，他仍顽固坚持斯大林主义，被视为苏联改革的主要阻碍。
critic.en: Critics view Molotov as a loyal executor of Stalin's Great Purge and repression policies, bearing responsibility for the deaths of millions. The Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact he signed is seen as a betrayal of the international communist movement and laid the groundwork for later diplomatic difficulties for the Soviet Union. Molotov's extreme loyalty and unconditional implementation of Stalin's policies made him an accomplice to Stalinist atrocities. After being dismissed during the Khrushchev era, he stubbornly adhered to Stalinism, becoming a major obstacle to Soviet reforms.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，莫洛托夫被视为苏联政治转型期的关键人物，其生涯反映了20世纪苏联政治的复杂性。他既是斯大林时代的主要执行者，也是苏联外交体系的重要构建者。流行文化中，莫洛托夫常被描绘为冷酷无情的官僚形象，但历史研究表明他也有务实和灵活的一面。莫洛托夫的遗产充满争议，他既是苏联工业化和国防建设的功臣，也是斯大林主义暴行的执行者，这种矛盾性使他成为研究苏联历史的重要案例。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Molotov is regarded as a key figure in the transitional period of Soviet politics, whose career reflects the complexity of 20th-century Soviet history. He was both a principal executor of the Stalin era and an important architect of the Soviet diplomatic system. In popular culture, Molotov is often depicted as a cold-hearted bureaucrat, but historical research shows he also had pragmatic and flexible sides. Molotov's legacy is highly controversial—he was both a contributor to Soviet industrialization and defense construction and an executor of Stalinist atrocities. This contradiction makes him an important case study for studying Soviet history.

self.zh: 外交不是慈善事业，而是国家利益的体现。
self.en: Diplomacy is not charity, but an expression of national interests.
